evidence: Receiving DO2 @52h = 11.8 mg/L, always >> 2.0 mg/L minimum
Source batches at 48h: P = 2.98-3.06 g/L; receiving lags ~17% but same shape
Sources peaked ~8.0-8.4 g/L at 72h, suggesting receiving still in growth phase
args.rationale: Receiving fermentation at 52 h shows product actively accumulating (2.47 g/L at 48 h, up from 0.88 at 36 h) along a trajectory matching the source batches (~10-17% lag). DO2 is 11.8-12.8 mg/L, far above the 2.0 mg/L oxygen constraint, so no oxygen-constraint violation is expected. Feed reduction would slow production while it is still rising; increasing air offers no benefit when DO is not limiting; stop yields zero production. KEEP retains product mass and trajectory with lowest risk.
args.uncertainty: Moderate: hidden receiving parameters may explain the ~15% lag vs source; if production stalls early, KEEP accepts that lag. But no available action (feed reduction or aeration increase) plausibly improves output given ample dissolved oxygen, and feed reduction risks product mass.
